title: TurnTraceRow
description: One durable row per LLM agent call (constitution §1/§3: append-only, reviewer-auditable years later). Extends T04's TraceRecord with the full payloads and orchestrator context. UPDATE/DELETE are blocked by the §3 trigger + REVOKE (already in place since T05).

id.description: Equals TraceRecord.id / ModelCallResult.trace_id — the correlation key across logs, ledger and this table.

turn_id.description: Orchestrator turn (uuid5, state-machine contract §6.9). Null for non-session calls (calibration, smoke scripts).

prompt_version.description: The prompts/<agent>/<version> in force at call time (from configs/models.yaml pin).

outcome.description: Mirrors TraceOutcome. Wrapper-level rejection of an ok call (agent contract miss) still records ok here — the wrapper outcome lives in `wrapper_outcome`.

wrapper_outcome.description: Populated only when knowable at the synchronous write time (e.g. supplied via caller context). NULL means the wrapper verdict was not available when the row was written — the definitive verdict is derivable downstream from session coverage markers (assessment_failed / gap markers) and the session_decision stream. §3 append-only forbids back-filling.

cost_usd.description: NUMERIC(12,6) serialized as string; Decimal end-to-end, never float.

prompt_sha.description: SHA-256 of the canonical prompt recipe (T04's canonical_prompt_sha).

system_prompt.description: Full assembled system prompt. Candidate PII never appears here by construction (system prompts are repo artifacts).

user_payload.description: Full serialized user payload — DOES contain candidate answers. This table is the audit trail (§1); access is role-gated at the API layer (T34/T39), never logged elsewhere (§15).

response_text.description: Raw model text before parsing. Populated by call_model since T21 (TraceRecord carries it to the sink); empty string for a call that never reached the model.

parsed.description: Schema-validated parsed output when outcome=ok; null otherwise. Populated by call_model since T21.

error_message.description: Secret-safe message for non-ok outcomes (wrapper already strips secrets).

transition.description: Orchestrator context when the call was issued by the state machine (state-machine contract §1). Null for non-session calls.

state_before_sha.description: SHA-256 of the canonical SessionState JSON before the transition that issued this call.
